name: DocuSign
label: DocuSign eSignature REST API v2.1
description: DocuSign eSignature REST API v2.1. Official API https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/. One node; pick operation. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Customer is the e-sign sender (ESIGN/eIDAS). Demo vs prod hosts. Paths use /accounts/{account_id}/…. Access token is minted outside StudioQuack. document_download OUTPUT is type file. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secret (hmac_key) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: envelope_create_from_template, envelope_send, envelope_get, envelope_void, document_download, recipient_list, bulk_send, listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: name
schema.description: File, folder, bucket, or display name.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `account_id` for operations: envelope_create_from_template, envelope_send, envelope_get, envelope_void, document_download, recipient_list, bulk_send. Required by: envelope_create_from_template, envelope_send, envelope_get, envelope_void, document_download, recipient_list, bulk_send. Blank INPUT falls back to config account_id.

schema.label: templateId
schema.description: envelope_create_from_template templateId (GUID string, not a number). Example: 44d9d7ba-....

schema.label: status
schema.description: Envelope status. create: created | sent. envelope_send: sent. envelope_void: voided.

schema.label: envelopeId
schema.description: URL path parameter `envelopeId` for operations: envelope_send, envelope_get, envelope_void, document_download, recipient_list. Required by: envelope_send, envelope_get, envelope_void, document_download, recipient_list.

schema.label: Envelope Id
schema.description: Envelope id (alias of envelopeId). Path param for get/void/document_download/recipient_list/send.

schema.label: documentId
schema.description: URL path parameter `documentId` for operation: document_download. Required by: document_download.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (hmac_key), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (JWT impersonation or auth-code). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Account GUID used in REST paths /v2.1/accounts/{account_id}/…. Used when INPUT account_id is blank.

configurationParameters.label: base_url
configurationParameters.description: DocuSign REST origin. Demo: https://demo.docusign.net/restapi/v2.1 . Production: https://{site}.docusign.net/restapi/v2.1.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Connect HMAC Key
configurationParameters.description: DocuSign Connect HMAC key for constant-time X-DocuSign-Signature-1 Base64 HMAC-SHA256 verification. Never logged.
